integrity: Full equations, exact coefficientwise polynomial identity, and independent rational diagnostic checks supplied in complete standalone files. No independence or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For two independent Brownian-noise particles driven by a common stationary two-state Markov environment with positive state-dependent damping and constant positive diffusion. No claim for multi-state modulation, interacting particles, or correlated noises; quantitative mixed-moment recursions were known before this sign factorization.
title: Exact signed energy correlations from counter-switching harmonic confinement
